context: Daichi chats with a delivery driver about the route.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: logistics chat; transport vocabulary (トラック/バック/彼ら/無い) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お、そのトラック、よう停めたなあ。
lines.en: Oh, you parked that truck well.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、後ろにバックするのが大変で。
lines.en: Yeah, backing it up is tough.
lines.style: modest office man voice, soft warm relatable delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 右側に、もう少し寄せたらええよ。
lines.en: You can pull a bit more to the right.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm helpful friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとう。今日は荷物が多くて。
lines.en: Thanks. There's a lot of cargo today.
lines.style: grateful office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 他の運転手は、もう来てへんの?
lines.en: Haven't the other drivers come yet?
lines.style: curious Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 彼らは、別の側から回るそうです。
lines.en: They're going around from the other side.
lines.style: informative office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほな、停める場所も、もう無いなあ。
lines.en: Then there's no parking spot left, huh.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm wry friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 彼らが来る前に、バックで入れます。
lines.en: I'll back in before they arrive.
lines.style: resolved office man voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
